name: H00_crow_dies_mills_two_once
note: Crow of Dark Tidings: 'When this creature enters or dies, mill two cards.' The Crow starts on the battlefield (no enters trigger) and dies to lethal damage (a 2/1 dealt 1): exactly one dies trigger, which mills the top two cards of its controller's library. Its own card is in the graveyard too; the opponent's library is untouched.
